chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:

The son of Adam will not do a deed greater before Allah, Mighty and Majestic, than a man who kills a Prophet, or demolishes the Ka'bah which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, made a qiblah for His servants, or pours his fluid unlawfully into a woman.

key_terms.ابْنُ آدَمَ: the human being; literally the son of Adam
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةَ: the sacred House in Makkah made the qiblah for worshippers
key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ حَرَامًا: a woman with whom intercourse is unlawful
key_terms.قِبْلَةً: the direction of prayer appointed for Allah's servants

ai.seo_question: What deeds are described in this hadith as among the greatest sins before Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies among the gravest sins acts that violate the sanctities established by Allah: murdering a Prophet, destroying the Ka'bah, and unlawful sexual discharge. It underscores the enormity of crimes against divine authority, sacred symbols, and sexual boundaries.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4921 - The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

"The son of Adam will not commit a deed greater in sin before Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, than a man who kills a prophet, or demolishes the Kaaba which Allah (swt), has made as a Qibla for His (swt) servants, or discharges his semen unlawfully in a woman."
